findings.summary: The holdout grow/run process was undocumented — calibration/README.md had no holdout section at all — so the mismatch between the private REPO name (davalst/tdd-playbook-holdout) and the conventional local clone DIR (~/tdd-holdout-vault) was a live trap: passing the dir name as the --vault URL failed `git clone` with exit 128 during a real run today. A process that only lives in one session's memory re-breaks the next session.
findings.disposition: Added a 'The private holdout' section to calibration/README.md: the two-tier rationale (public tunable corpus vs private unseen answer key), the NAME TRAP called out explicitly with the git-clone-128 failure mode and the get-url confirmation command, the security invariant (the answer key never enters the public repo/CI/a Claude verifier's context; a Claude model must NOT read proposed/ or bodies/), the grow loop (author with a DIFFERENT --category per parallel run to avoid id collisions -> human reviews proposed/ -> approve BOTH plant and control -> commit+push the vault), and the run command (run --vault <repo-url> --model sonnet --summary, with the local-path option to skip auth). Also recorded in the project memory two-tier-calibration-program (name trap + pointer to the README as canonical). No code changed; this is a documentation-durability fix.
